items.titleEn: 马斯克的成功，在于坚持
items.titleZh: 马斯克的成功，在于坚持
items.teaserEn: 马斯克在众多质疑声中，和一次次失败之后，仍然说了已经：我永不放弃。
items.teaserZh: 马斯克在众多质疑声中，和一次次失败之后，仍然说了已经：我永不放弃。
items.introZh: 马斯克在众多质疑声中，和一次次失败之后，仍然说了已经：我永不放弃。

items.titleEn: 马斯克的成功，在于坚持
items.titleZh: 马斯克的成功，在于坚持
items.teaserEn: 马斯克在众多质疑声中，和一次次失败之后，仍然说了已经：我永不放弃。
items.teaserZh: 马斯克在众多质疑声中，和一次次失败之后，仍然说了已经：我永不放弃。
items.introZh: 马斯克在众多质疑声中，和一次次失败之后，仍然说了已经：我永不放弃。

items.teaserEn: I read it to understand the brain’s default. The biggest takeaway: build forced pauses into high-stakes decisions.
items.teaserZh: 三十多年的判断与决策研究，被压成一本可读的书。核心一句话：你的大脑是两套系统——快而直觉的一套，慢而审慎的一套。
items.introEn: System 1 drives; System 2 sleeps. Most mistakes come from letting the fast one drive.
items.introZh: 系统 1 负责开车，系统 2 负责打盹。聪明人犯错的地图。

quote.textEn: Nothing in life is as important as you think it is, while you are thinking about it.
quote.textZh: 生活里没有什么事，会像你以为的那么重要——至少在你正在想它的那一刻。
quote.srcZh: — 丹尼尔·卡尼曼，《思考，快与慢》

items.teaserEn: I use reverse-thinking and probability thinking every week. Before a meeting I ask: how would I make this fail?
items.teaserZh: 不是讲“什么是思维模型”的认知书，而是讲“哪些思维模型最值得收藏”的工具手册。
items.introEn: First-principles, second-order thinking, the map is not the territory.
items.introZh: 第一性原理、二阶思维、地图不等于疆域。

quote.textEn: When all you have is a hammer, everything looks like a nail. But check first.
quote.textZh: 当你手里有把锤子，你看什么都像钉子。但首先看看是不是钉子。
quote.srcZh: — 沙恩·帕里什，《思考的框架》

items.teaserEn: I treat it as my weekly report filter. Conclusion up top, supporting logic below.
items.teaserZh: 教你把混乱的素材装进一个金字塔，让表达变得有效。
items.introEn: Conclusion first, then MECE groups. The McKinsey writing bible.
items.introZh: 结论先行，以上统下。麦肯锡的写作圣经。

quote.textEn: Think top-down: state the answer, then support it.
quote.textZh: 思考自顶向下：先给答案，再给支撑。
quote.srcZh: — 芭芭拉·明托，《金字塔原理》

items.teaserEn: I borrowed the "golden thread" metaphor for my weekly notes: what is this week’s golden thread?
items.teaserZh: 中文学界少有的讲清楚如何把事做成的书。
items.introEn: Beyond the pyramid: the golden thread of structured thinking.
items.introZh: 在金字塔原理之上，结构化思维的成事之线。

quote.textEn: Structured thinking is not about pretty writing — it is about getting things done.
quote.textZh: 结构化思维不是把话写漂亮——是把事做出来。
quote.srcZh: — 冯唐，《金线》

items.teaserEn: I now write three lines after every long read: who is the protagonist, why does it matter, what do I do tomorrow.
items.teaserZh: 把"表达不清"这件事拆解到三个动作里。
items.introEn: Collect, sort, deliver — three moves that make a sentence land.
items.introZh: 收集—整理—传达，三步把话说到点子上。

quote.textEn: Clarity is the highest courtesy you can offer yourself.
quote.textZh: 说得清，是对自己最大的礼貌。
quote.srcZh: — 山口拓朗，《概括力》

items.teaserEn: The first lesson: the crowd is not "wrong" — it is a triggered system with patterns you can read.
items.teaserZh: 一个世纪前的群体心理学预见，从弹幕到股价都还在证明它。
items.introEn: Written in 1895, still explains every comment section today.
items.introZh: 1895 年写的书，今天读还是新的。

quote.textEn: The crowd is the slave of its passions.
quote.textZh: 群体是激情的奴隶。
quote.srcZh: — 古斯塔夫·勒庞，《乌合之众》

items.teaserEn: My practice: a daily block of empty time — no tasks, no messages, no scrolling. The antidote to scarcity.
items.teaserZh: 从脑科学和经济学的双重视角证明——稀缺不是缺少，是注意力被占用。
items.introEn: Scarcity taxes your bandwidth — busy becomes a trap, not a badge.
items.introZh: 稀缺心态收的是「带宽税」：越忙越笨，越穷越亏。

quote.textEn: Scarcity is not about having less — it is about having less mental bandwidth.
quote.textZh: 稀缺不是缺什么——是缺乏脑力带宽。
quote.srcZh: — 塞德希尔·穆来纳森，《稀缺》

items.teaserEn: It was published in 2006. The future it predicted is now: design, story, and empathy are the most-valued skills.
items.teaserZh: 从信息时代到概念时代的过渡——审美、故事与共情最被珍视。
items.introEn: The Conceptual Age: why right-brainers will rule the future.
items.introZh: 概念时代：为什么右脑思维者将统治未来。

quote.textEn: We are entering a new age that places a premium on the right-brain qualities.
quote.textZh: 我们正在进入一个珍惜右脑特质的时代。
quote.srcEn: — Daniel H. Pink,A Whole New Mind
quote.srcZh: — 丹尼尔·平克，《全新思维》

items.teaserEn: I reframed Munger’s "every problem looks like a nail with a hammer" into "first check whether it is a nail".
items.teaserZh: 不是一本通常意义上的商业书。是一个九旬老人的讲话集。
items.introEn: Invert, always invert. The latticework of mental models.
items.introZh: 反过来想，总是反过来想。多元思维格栅。

quote.textEn: All I want to know is where I’m going to die, so I’ll never go there.
quote.textZh: 我只想知道我会在哪里死，这样我就永远不会去那里。
quote.srcZh: — 查理·芒格，《穷查理宝典》

items.teaserEn: I started writing "daily principles" — small lines that I try to live by and adjust over time.
items.teaserZh: 表面是个人原则集，实质是一套让生活被审视、被迭代的方法。
items.introEn: Radical truth, radical transparency. Pain + reflection = progress.
items.introZh: 极度求真、极度透明。痛苦 + 反思 = 进步。

quote.textEn: Pain plus reflection equals progress.
quote.textZh: 痛苦加反思等于进步。
quote.srcZh: — 瑞·达利欧，《原则》

items.teaserEn: I now block two hours a week purely for focused reading — the "focus itself is wealth" muscle.
items.teaserZh: 从中文学界视角写的乔布斯传，把心性的哲学与高端商业嫁接起来。
items.introEn: Four powers of the mind: will, focus, creativity, insight.
items.introZh: 愿力、专注力、创新力、洞察力——四种心力的修炼。

quote.textEn: Investing is the training of the mind.
quote.textZh: 投资是心性修炼。
quote.srcZh: — 李国飞，《乔布斯、禅与投资》

items.teaserEn: It changed my belief: environment beats resource in shaping outcomes — backed by field research.
items.teaserZh: 重新审视贫穷是不是真的只缺钱。
items.introEn: Nobel laureates on why poverty is trapped by decisions, not money.
items.introZh: 诺奖得主的研究：贫穷陷阱困住的不是钱，是决策环境。

quote.textEn: Poverty is about the small things that get in the way of the big ones.
quote.textZh: 贫穷是拦在小事前的大事。
quote.srcZh: — 阿比吉特·班纳吉 / 埃斯特·迪弗洛，《贫穷的本质》

items.teaserEn: Different industries are not separate — they are physics + software. Space, cars, brain-computer are the same.
items.teaserZh: 马斯克火箭、电动车、脑机接口背后那个"问为什么"的人物侧写。
items.introEn: The authorized biography. First-principles thinking, taken to extremes.
items.introZh: 官方授权传记。把第一性原理用到极致的偏执狂。

quote.textEn: I think ordinary people can choose to be extraordinary.
quote.textZh: 普通人也可以选择变得不普通。
quote.srcZh: — 阿什利·万斯，《硅谷钢铁侠》

items.teaserEn: Even "impossible" projects become achievable once broken into small, rhythmic steps.
items.teaserZh: 人、商业、技术三角并行的"特斯拉制造史"。
items.introEn: How Tesla turned "impossible" into a shipping product.
items.introZh: 特斯拉如何把"不可能"造出来、卖出去。

quote.textEn: Impossible is just a label we put on things we haven’t yet broken down.
quote.textZh: 不可能只是我们还没分解的标签。
quote.srcZh: — 哈米什·麦肯齐，《特斯拉传：实现不可能》

items.titleEn: The Last Quarter of the Moon
items.teaserEn: It is the tone that moves me — a voice of a civilization fading by your side.
items.teaserZh: 茅奖作品。一个民族与最后一名记录者，在黑龙江梡木里。
items.introEn: A ninety-year-old Ewenki woman tells a century in one day.
items.introZh: 一位九十岁的鄂温克老人，用一天讲完一百年。

quote.textEn: The older a story is, the truer it tends to be.
quote.textZh: 我所说的事情，越古就越真实。
quote.srcEn: — Chi Zijian,The Last Quarter of the Moon
quote.srcZh: — 迟子建，《额尔古纳河右岸》

items.titleEn: Life and Death Are Wearing Me Out
items.teaserEn: I read it as language exercise. Mo Yan’s sentences "rewind and rewind" — irony is a craft, not a mood.
items.teaserZh: 诺奖得主以轮回机巧穿梭五十年中国乡土。
items.introEn: Six reincarnations — donkey, ox, pig, dog, monkey — fifty years of rural China.
items.introZh: 六道轮回看五十年乡土中国。

quote.textEn: Everything else is loud. One thing is voice.
quote.textZh: 一切都是高音调的事，独一个是声音。
quote.srcEn: — Mo Yan,Life and Death Are Wearing Me Out
quote.srcZh: — 莫言，《生死瘦劳》

items.teaserEn: Late night read. I thought: "a life without being shaken by a book is still a complete life." Then I respected reading.
items.teaserZh: 德律斯顿表炸之后，才子的生活崩塌。
items.introEn: So it goes. Black humor that outlives the firebombing it came from.
items.introZh: "事情就是这样。"黑色幽默写尽战争的荒诞。

quote.textEn: So it goes.
quote.textZh: 事情就是这样。
quote.srcZh: — 库尔特·冯内古特，《五号屠场》

items.teaserEn: A book that leaves you wordless. Some gates are too narrow for two people.
items.teaserZh: 纪德获诺奖的小说。一个女子为完美主义拒绝爱情。
items.introEn: Faith and love pull in opposite directions — into the narrow gate.
items.introZh: 通往幸福的门那么窄。信仰与爱的极致拉扯。

quote.textEn: Happiness is not for patchwork.
quote.textZh: 幸福不适宜拼凑。
quote.srcZh: — 安德烈·纪德，《窄门》

items.teaserEn: My most-remembered line: no savior will come, only yourself. I re-read the book every year for it.
items.teaserZh: 丁元英是一个"只能被谈论的人物"。多谈市场、私募、信任。
items.introEn: Culture decides destiny. Strong culture, weak culture, no savior coming.
items.introZh: 文化属性决定命运。强势文化与弱势文化，救世主不会来。

quote.textEn: Give a man a fish; teach a man to fish.
quote.textZh: 授人鱼不如授人以渔。
quote.srcZh: — 豆豆，《遥远的救世主》

items.titleEn: Beyond the Dust of the World
items.teaserEn: When tempted to imitate, I recall "do not walk the road others walked". A guardrail for originality.
items.teaserZh: 最被低估的豆豆三部曲之一。
items.introEn: See the road, but don’t walk it — the philosophy finale.
items.introZh: "见路不走"。豆豆三部曲的哲学收官。

quote.textEn: See the road, but don’t walk it.
quote.textZh: 见路不走。
quote.srcEn: — Dou Dou,Beyond the Dust of the World
quote.srcZh: — 豆豆，《天幕红尘》

items.teaserEn: A friend told me: "betrayal is not which side you chose — it is which choices you have left."
items.teaserZh: 豆豆三部曲的中间一部。事业与"出卖"的论。
items.introEn: Tao without craft is still attainable; craft without Tao stops at craft.
items.introZh: "有道无术，术尚可求也；有术无道，止于术。"

quote.textEn: Tao without craft is still attainable.
quote.textZh: 有道无术，术尚可求也。
quote.srcZh: — 豆豆，《背叛》

items.teaserEn: I wanted to see how an author talks about life across books. She outsmarts her author.
items.teaserZh: 豆豆"闭上股找个狗"——作者不完全照作者人设谈人生的第一本。
items.introEn: The debut novella — you can already see the later books in it.
items.introZh: 豆豆的处女作。已见后来三部曲的影子。

quote.textEn: Running from life is the root of every problem.
quote.textZh: 人出走问题是逃避的根源。
quote.srcEn: — Dou Dou,Dying Is Easier Than Living
quote.srcZh: — 豆豆，《死比活着容易》

items.titleEn: At the Bend of the River
items.teaserEn: "身正不怕影子歪。" This line works outside the bureaucracy too.
items.teaserZh: 陈行甲退到转身人生所有不甘。
items.introEn: From star county secretary to public-welfare worker. Sincerity wins.
items.introZh: 从全国优秀县委书记到公益人。

quote.textEn: An upright body does not fear a crooked shadow.
quote.textZh: 身正不怕影子歪。
quote.srcEn: — Chen Xingjia,At the Bend of the River
quote.srcZh: — 陈行甲，《在峡江的转弯处》

items.teaserEn: Difficulty is not money — it is seniority, relationship, social order.
items.teaserZh: 老郭五十写过的"人间世"。
items.introEn: Rules of life, dinner-table etiquette, and show-business feuds at fifty.
items.introZh: 五十岁郭德纲的处世规矩与江湖人情。

quote.textEn: The world is not about fighting — it is about feelings and favors.
quote.textZh: 江湖不是打打杀杀，江湖是人情世故。
quote.srcZh: — 郭德纲，《刚刚说过》

items.teaserEn: "护脾子" is family, not dining. Reading the book gives you a new view of hierarchy.
items.teaserZh: 老郭相声三十多年的人文集。
items.introEn: The crosstalk world’s rules and hearts — jokes outside, life inside.
items.introZh: 相声江湖的规矩与人心。

quote.textEn: Without the bitterest hardship, one cannot rise.
quote.textZh: 不受苦中苦，难为人上人。
quote.srcZh: — 郭德纲，《过得刚好》

items.teaserEn: Patience with language and posture. Eat the meal with care — not for show.
items.teaserZh: 老郭真正抱着"捡就拘了·讲德位"的书。
items.introEn: History, folk customs, and street wisdom.
items.introZh: 捡史、讲俗、拾遗。民间文化的扫地僧。

quote.textEn: Speaking is an art.
quote.textZh: 说话是艺术。
quote.srcZh: — 郭德纲，《郭论》

items.teaserEn: Reading this book feels like playing. Not "chicken soup" — solid psychology from the 80s.
items.teaserZh: 三十多年前的书，预见了互联网时代的"注意力问题"。
items.introEn: Happiness is not having — it is being fully absorbed.
items.introZh: 幸福不是拥有什么，是全神贯注于什么。

quote.textEn: Optimal experience is flow.
quote.textZh: 最优体验是心流。
quote.srcZh: — 米哈里·契克森米哈赖，《心流》

items.teaserEn: When stuck, I ask: is this the first time I see this problem? If not, see it as the first time.
items.teaserZh: 佛门弟子讲"开始心"，说"准备子在世能被联在生活中"。
items.introEn: In the beginner’s mind there are many possibilities.
items.introZh: 初心不是一次拥有，而是随时回去。

quote.textEn: Beginner’s mind is the mind that knows nothing in particular.
quote.textZh: 初心的意思是什么都不会。
quote.srcZh: — 铃木俊隆，《禅者的初心》

items.teaserEn: The moment of "I want X" is not getting X. That understanding saves me from a few dopamine traps.
items.teaserZh: 拆解欲望、快乐、遗憾的脑科学书。
items.introEn: Dopamine isn’t pleasure — it is wanting.
items.introZh: 多巴胺不是快乐，是"想要"。

quote.textEn: Wanting is not happiness.
quote.textZh: 欲望不是快乐。
quote.srcEn: — Daniel Z. Lieberman,The Molecule of More
quote.srcZh: — 丹尼尔·利伯曼，《贪婪的多巴胺》

items.teaserEn: I recognized the "internal judged listener" pattern. Not born — built up by accumulated judgments.
items.teaserZh: 一本能读得懂的心理书。
items.introEn: Where low self-esteem comes from, and the way out.
items.introZh: "我不好、我不行、我不配"的根源与出路。

quote.textEn: Don’t judge myself. It is enough to not be judged by others.
quote.textZh: 不背扣我不。下不被别人扣就够了。
quote.srcZh: — 斯蒂芬妮·斯塔尔，《认同自己》

items.teaserEn: I learned: "you can reframe the world by changing the question." Better questions, better science.
items.teaserZh: 关于"为什么会是这样"的书。从"看上去那个样"出发。
items.introEn: Ten keys to reality, by a Nobel physicist.
items.introZh: 诺奖物理学家的世界运行十原理。

quote.textEn: Why is it this way? That is just a question.
quote.textZh: 为什么会是这样，本来只是问问题。
quote.srcZh: — 弗兰克·维尔切克，《万物原理》

items.teaserEn: Most readers see "a man with goods". I see a man dwelling in inner phenomenology.
items.teaserZh: 艾萨克森写乔布斯、爱因斯坦、富兰克林、达·芬奇。
items.introEn: The exclusive biography, in the original.
items.introZh: 唯一授权传记英文原版。疯狂到改变世界的人。

quote.textEn: Strive to be a person of value.
quote.textZh: 努力成为一个有价值的人。
quote.srcZh: — 沃尔特·艾萨克森，《史蒂夫·乔布斯》

items.teaserEn: Two takeaways: question the requirement, delete the step. Try "ask whether I am the right person".
items.teaserZh: 与其说是马斯克传记，不如说是"用马斯克讲方法论"。
items.introEn: By the author of The Almanack of Naval: Musk’s methods.
items.introZh: 《纳瓦尔宝典》作者编的马斯克方法论。

quote.textEn: First-principles thinking is the move.
quote.textZh: 第一性原理是一个动作。
quote.srcZh: — 埃里克·乔根森，《马斯克之书》

items.titleEn: Strictly Business: The Story of Kwek Leng Beng
items.teaserEn: Entrepreneurship is opportunities, not motion. Singapore teaches stillness.
items.teaserZh: 新加坡酒店、百货、置业的商业家族史。
items.introEn: The story of CDL’s Kwek Leng Beng — a Singapore business saga.
items.introZh: 新加坡城市发展集团郭令明的商业传奇。

quote.textEn: You cannot become a machine. But you can prepare.
quote.textZh: 你不能变机。但你能预付。
quote.srcEn: — Singapore business biography,Strictly Business: The Story of Kwek Leng Beng
quote.srcZh: — （新加坡商业传记），《纯商业：郭令明的故事》
